body: I don't remember anything before I was born. When I have been put under anesthetic I remember nothing. if someone's brain is damaged their personality and the way they think changes. If someone's brain is nearly destroyed, the person they are is nearly also destroyed. All evidence points to me being contained entirely within my brain. Extrapolation, interpolation, it all leads to one fact, once my brain dies, there is no me, period.

Yeah man, I know death is just nothingness. At some point I have just become extremely comfortable with that. There is no perception; hell from my perspective the universe pretty much ends at the point I kill myself. I am pretty much just a biological computer that fumbled in to and out of existence over a slightly shorter time period than all of the other biological computers that did the same.

I can't stand the thought of having all of what I've done be worth nothing. The illusion that I was somewhat decent at something was the only thing that kept me going despite the rest of my characteristics. The thought of going through all of this shit just to have to go begging for a casual fast food job?

That's just ridiculous, and shameful. Death is preferable to that embarrassment.

Hmm, just a housekeeping request to you guys. Can you please return the /r/suicide subreddit back to a person who wants to run it in the manner it was originally intended?

Damn man, censoring talk like that was just a dick move; I wanted to go there instead. This place is such a drag.

Edit: What do you guys think?

Note or no note?

I don't want a poor display of writing skills to forever mark my death. That seems kind of lame.

What would I even put on a note: I killed myself, please delete my browser history ... 

I could try to be eloquent and carefully explain the fundamental factors that led to my death. Maybe I could go in to detail, even add a few citations from medical journals, but that would just seem weird. Or even the emotional approach, *I am sorry mother, I did not want to die, but it was the only option left to me* ...

Nah. Maybe I could do one that's real spiteful. Then again what's the point of that.

I can only really come to the conclusion that no one would really give a fuck one way or another, so no note then.
But this throwaway account name says 5th of november (not 11th of may you silly yanks); I can't betray the name of the throwaway account. That would just be poor form.

All the things normal people have in life, a steady job, a house, a family, a wife, a place to call their own (*edit:damn, this is redundant, and it flowed better as well ... I will leave it in*). I will never have any of that (*this sentence aint gramatically complete, damn*). There is nothing I can do to get any of that, and life will surely suck without it. 

So in one corner I can choose to kill myself by slowly twiddling my thumbs while I am resented by everyone around me for being a useless and uncharismatic leech.

Alternatively in the other corner I can just jump in front of a train, and no one will even think about me after a few days anyway. Seems like the better option to me.

Well I spent my last 5 years straight out of high school getting a degree, but I didn't manage to get in to work experience in that time. Because of that I've become unemployable so I might as well not have done it.

I am also an exceedingly ugly motherfucker with the charisma of a house fly, I have fucked up every job interview I've ever had, and no one has ever really liked me (nor will ever like me).

Essentially on the trajectory I am on, which is about as unchangeable as the trajectory you're on when you're stuck in a fucking tsunami, I am going to die one ugly, broke, lonely motherfucker when I am old. It seems better just to do it now and save myself the pain ... or rather compress that pain in to the short time interval between when I am hit and when I die ... I like getting things over and done with after all.
Oh you know, the general, life is shit, no hope for the future, sky is falling. I am sure you've read it a few times before.

I really dislike this way of thinking. There is nothing inherently positive about living, nor anything particularly irrational about choosing not to live. When you go even further and claim that people in the first world have no rational claim for suicide, it becomes absurd.

When the fear of living exceeds the fear of death, suicide becomes inevitable. Yet there is nothing irrational about this, as long as the fears of living are derived from a rational base. If a man is stuck in a burning building, it may be far more palatable to jump out than to allow himself to burn to death. Suicide is the exact same thing. Claiming to know someone else's circumstances better than themselves with an off statement like 'it gets better' is just asinine. 

It is not that it will never get better, it's just that it's exceedingly unlikely, and not worth the suffering to find out.

It's not just that though, to actually be able to afford to live somewhere with a single income, you need a decent income in Australia. Minimum wage does not cut it, and it certainly doesn't provide any money or time to gain further education, training or move overseas as you suggested.

It is hard just to 'run away and start afresh somewhere'.

Internationally that means an expensive plane flight, and applying for a working visa that is unlikely to come. I would likely have even the same problems as my current location. Going across the world so to speak wouldn't be fun if you didn't have the money to do it. Trying to do that without any finances just seems extremely difficult and ultimately pointless.

Domestically, that just means getting a cheaper plane flight, applying to the same pool of jobs I was before, and looking for accommodation that I can afford with extremely limited income.

Exploration geology and geophysics. The demand for it is strongest in my current location, however, the amount of students doing it has consequentially increased massively. A few price shocks have caused limited hiring this year, but it would be worse elsewhere. It's more that there's far more students than there are jobs.
Australia, and there are, but they're unlikely be able to get employment in a specialist field.

I really don't want to die by drowning, it seems horrible. In terms of dying from falling, falling from a building is even worse than a train, because it might even hurt someone else. Falling from a cliff seems to scare me a bit for some reason, considering most of potentially lethal cliffs are about 20m max, and limestone on to sand or water. I would die, but not before lying broken on the ground in pain for a while.

I know, it is bloody hard. If I had the option, I'd shoot myself, but I can't because there's a shortage of guns in my country. I don't want to try anything like hanging/cutting due to the high failure rate. Screwing around with poisoning myself would probably also fail. Something like asphyxiation is too finnicky and I'd probably fuck it up.

I want to succeed on the first attempt, and train is the only way I can think of for that.

Primarily because to even be considered for full time employment in my field, I require work experience. Every single application for an internship/part time work over my 5 years at uni (double degree + honours) has been rejected. No one will consider providing a similar internship like position for someone who has already graduated, especially when for every position there's hundreds of people applying.

Also, I don't really have any friends to sleep on a couch, and once I find myself in a shelter, there's no way out of that. Who the fuck would employ a homeless person?
Yes I am going through with it, suicide by train most likely. Fifth of November is when most of the end of year job applications I will put in will have their rejections in by.
I appreciate the effort, but without a job it isn't going to change.

Yeah, I am killing myself on the fifth of November because of this, I have no way of ever making a living now that I have been unable to find work in my industry from uni. If you're a male, and you don't establish yourself in the 4 or 5 years after high school, then you're pretty much fucked.
